В безэховой камере (фон ниже −9 дБ) опер:
In the anechoic chamber (background below −9 dB), operators report a persistent “second echo”: their own pulse, repeated 0.4 seconds later from the opposite direction.

Measurements confirm a real, localized, moving source. No mass is detected while the source is silent.

E. M. Vainshtein’s hypothesis: in sufficient silence, sound returns to someone other than its maker. The source reaches for sound. When it receives sound, it acquires form.

Practical finding: a loud object thrown aside draws the source away. It hears footsteps on water and broken glass at twice the distance.

Continue the work. Do not inform the operators.
